title: Lightly Spiced Egyptian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic one-pot dish featuring chicken breasts, ferment-kimchi, and a blend of Egyptian spices, cooked to perfection in a cataplana vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chicken breasts and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chopped ferment-kimchi, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice or couscous.
